entry.name: PULSE
entry.title: PULSE: A Synchronized Five-Modality Dataset for Multi-Modal Daily Activity Understanding
entry.summary: 40 volunteers wore 25-channel fingertip pressure arrays on both hands (values in grams) together with Qualisys mocap, a Myo EMG armband, Dikablis eye tracking and 10 IMUs in 8 household and office scenarios, all resampled to 100 Hz.
entry.hand: Custom fingertip pressure arrays on both hands (25 channels per hand)

sensor.note: aligned_pressure_100hz.csv: time + R1(g)-R25(g) + L1(g)-L25(g), resampled to 100 Hz from a ~15 Hz native log; channel placement on the fingers not documented. Present in 232 of 337 recordings (69.7% of task recordings). Isolated spikes far above grip level occur (v25/s2 L23 18,688 g, v12/s5 16,433 g).

scale.text: ~9.6 h (S1-S8 6.8 h + S9 2.9 h), 337 recordings (304 task + 33 motion-primitive), 40 volunteers, 8 scenarios, 7,356 action segments over 18 primitives and 54 objects; pressure in 232 recordings (~6.7 h)

entry.access: Hugging Face velvet-pine-22/PULSE, not gated, 22.0 GB of per-recording 100 Hz CSVs; scene video only for one recording in velvet-pine-22/PULSE-sample.
caveats: Anonymous NeurIPS 2026 E&D submission under double-blind review; authors, institution and the permanent URL are withheld.

The README describes per-recording videos/ folders (scene camera + eye video, ~86 GB in total), but the repository tree has none (22.0 GB); one recording (v1/s1) with both videos is in velvet-pine-22/PULSE-sample.
Pressure covers 69.7% of task recordings: volunteers v1-v22 have intermittent pressure and mocap, v14 has neither.
Pressure is logged at ~15 Hz and resampled to 100 Hz; the layout of the 25 channels per hand is not documented.
LICENSE adds restrictions to CC BY-NC 4.0: no re-identification, no covert worker surveillance or biometric identification, no redistribution of scene video outside academic research.
Action segments were generated by vision-language models and then confirmed or corrected by a human; boundaries have 1 s resolution and cover ~73% of annotated time.
IMU CSV headers are in Chinese (e.g. WT0_加速度X_g [WT0 acceleration X, g]); units are in the header suffixes.
v20/s2 IMU units WT4-WT7 are corrupted; v18/s2 egocentric video froze and has no action labels (README).

tracking.note: 56 joints incl. all 10 fingertips; aligned CSV has 210 columns (Frame, Time, per-marker X/Y/Z/Type); raw Qualisys TSV in raw/
fingertip, finger-segment and hand markers per hand (e.g. Q_RThumbTip, Q_RIndex2, Q_RHandIn)
acc, gyro, angle, magnetometer, quaternion, temperature, battery per unit

other: EMG: Myo Armband, 8 channels, dominant forearm (20-450 Hz band-pass, rectified)
eye tracking: Dikablis Glasses 3, 24 numeric features
scene camera (Dikablis Glasses 3, 1280x720, 25 fps) and eye video: recorded, released only for v1/s1 in PULSE-sample
action segments with natural-language descriptions (4 paraphrases each)

sources: https://huggingface.co/datasets/velvet-pine-22/PULSE (README.md, LICENSE, DATASHEET.md, croissant.json, metadata/recordings.csv, metadata/batch_alignment_summary.json, annotations_flat/segments.csv, annotations/v25/s2.json, full repo tree via API)

https://huggingface.co/datasets/velvet-pine-22/PULSE data/v25/s2 (aligned_pressure_100hz.csv, alignment_metadata.json, first 30 KB of the other aligned CSVs) and aligned_pressure_100hz.csv of v1/s1, v35/s3, v39/s4, v12/s5, v2/s6, v26/s7, v28/s8
unconfirmed: Native pressure rate ~15 Hz derived from v25/s2 alignment_metadata.json: 12,376 pressure rows between 17:27:24.698 and 17:41:19.457 (834.8 s). The card states only the 100 Hz aligned rate.
taxels_per_hand=25 is the channel count per hand; the card calls it a 'fingertip pressure array' and gives no layout, so coverage=tip is the card's wording.
calibrated=true from the '(g)' unit in every pressure column header; the calibration method is not stated.
frames=3,470,831 is the sum of n_samples_100hz in metadata/recordings.csv (100 Hz samples over all recordings); hours=9.64 is the sum of duration_sec; pressure-bearing recordings sum to 6.70 h.
tasks=8 counts scenarios S1-S8; S9 is an isolated motion-primitive protocol without mocap, video or action labels.
Availability: card YAML carries an extra_gated_prompt but the HF API reports gated=false and files resolve without accepting terms (checked 2026-10-17).
Chinese IMU headers point to a Chinese-speaking lab; the institution is withheld and the release gives no Chinese name, so no zh entry.
v2/s6 pressure CSV spans 57.0 s while recordings.csv lists 76.49 s for the recording.

sample.fetch_estimate: ~370 MB: aligned CSVs of the 8 recordings (37-84 MB each; skip raw/ TSVs) + v1/s1 scene video (100 MB) from PULSE-sample. Pressure CSVs (~15 MB) are already fetched under the survey scratch directory.
sample.rules_applied: 9 scenarios (> 6): S1-S8 taken, S9 skipped (motion-primitive protocol, no mocap, video or labels). One recording per scenario from 8 different volunteers, each with all five modalities and dense annotations; v1/s1 chosen for S1 because it is the only recording with released video. Other picks: duration closest to 75 s. Windows: the 60 s span with the most channel-samples above 20 g; recordings of 60 s or less are taken whole.
deviations: No video for 7 of 8 episodes: the main repository has none.
Pressure spikes above 5,000 g in v25/s2 and v12/s5 are kept as released and noted.
